# DSO Nordic

> Automated vehicle disinfection gate for farms, designed and manufactured in
> Estonia by FerWorks OÜ. Built for Northern European conditions: it operates
> from −20 °C to +40 °C with a disinfection cycle of up to 60 seconds.

DSO Nordic reduces the risk of pathogens such as African swine fever and
foot-and-mouth disease entering a farm on vehicle surfaces. Liquid is applied
from four directions — above, below and both sides — as the vehicle passes
through at roughly 2.4 km/h.

## Key specifications
- Operating temperature: −20 °C to +40 °C
- Cycle duration: up to 60 seconds; 5–7 second delay before spraying starts
- Spray rate: 100 L/min at approximately 4 bar
- Internal dimensions: 4.0 m × 4.8 m (W × H); external 5.4 m × 5.1 m
- Material: galvanised and stainless steel
- Tank: 1000 L IBC container (PE)
- Power: 380 V / IP66, CEE 16A three-phase
- Noise level: ≤ 70 dB(A)
- Installation area: 7 m × 3 m on asphalt, concrete or compacted aggregate
- Vehicle limits: max height 4 m, min ground clearance 120 mm
- Disinfectant: approx. 1% solution, chloramine-T based
- Lead time: 6–8 weeks
- Conformity: EC Declaration of Conformity covering applicable machinery and EMC requirements
